question_en:
I am compiling a publicly reusable dermoscopy teaching atlas and currently only have the attached original image without any description. Please answer the following questions in order.
1. Which record in the original public case database corresponds to the attached image? Please provide the database name, image ID, officially recorded diagnosis, the ID and name of the associated locked set, and its DOI. Also, list all image IDs from the official public image list for that DOI version as the subsequent candidate range.
2. To select teaching examples demonstrating imaging artifacts, please examine each of the candidate images from question (1) one by one. Identify images that simultaneously meet the following conditions: no measurement scale markings are visible in the image; there are obvious blue-purple marker strokes, or multiple long dark hairs that cross each other. Short stubble and scattered, non-crossing hairs do not count. Please list the IDs of all images meeting these conditions.
3. From the images confirmed to meet the visual conditions in question (2), filter for those with an official record indicating the head and neck region, age of at least 70 years, histopathological confirmation, and a CC-BY license. Select the single image with an age closest to 70 years as the representative image. What is the image ID of the final representative image?

Answer Format: For question 1, provide the database, input image ID, diagnosis, locked set ID and name, and DOI in text, and list all image IDs for that DOI version. For question 2, list all visually matching image IDs in text. For question 3, provide the final representative image ID in text.
answer:
Question 1: Database: ISIC Archive; Input Image ID: ISIC_1464567; Diagnosis: Basal cell carcinoma; Locked Set ID: 471; Set Name: 15 Exemplar Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinomas; DOI: 10.34970/270976.
All Image IDs: ISIC_0407770; ISIC_1464567; ISIC_3191609; ISIC_3368003; ISIC_3397948; ISIC_3740523; ISIC_4458593; ISIC_5608281; ISIC_5954593; ISIC_6088615; ISIC_7262547; ISIC_7986462; ISIC_8338562; ISIC_8384098; ISIC_9413831.

Question 2: ISIC_3368003; ISIC_5954593; ISIC_7262547; ISIC_8338562; ISIC_9413831.

Question 3: ISIC_7262547.
